our_interpretation: In context, the denied achievement is AI contributing to curing all disease, as discussed in Hassabis's referenced interview.
This is not a prediction that AI will make no useful medical contributions.
The next decade runs from the post date through August 17, 2036.
Curing disease means clinically demonstrated cures in people, rather than proposed molecules, laboratory findings or faster drug design.
criteria.support_condition: At the deadline, reliable clinical evidence establishes that AI has not delivered the broad disease-curing achievement described in the referenced interview.
criteria.contradiction_condition: By the deadline, clinical evidence establishes that AI materially contributed to demonstrated cures across the full disease scope described by Hassabis.
